statement:
∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ),
  IsOpen U →
    IsPreconnected U →
      DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → DifferentiableOn ℂ g U → ∀ z₀ ∈ U, (∃ᶠ (z : ℂ) in 𝓝[≠] z₀, f z = g z) → EqOn f g U

universal.type: ∃ᶠ (z : ℂ) in 𝓝[≠] z₀, f z = g z
universal.name: h

hyps.text: ∃ᶠ (z : ℂ) in 𝓝[≠] z₀, f z = g z
hyps.name: h
